metadata.title: Book a consultation — Enzo Interiors
metadata.description: Book a free home consultation with Enzo Interiors. Five quick steps, no obligation, and a survey before anyone talks about price.

panel.lede: Choose a date and time that suits you. We'll come to your home, discuss your ideas, and provide expert advice — completely free.

service.heading: What are you interested in?
service.lede: Select the service you'd like to discuss.
service.tierNote: Pre-filled from your {tier} tier quote request.

details.heading: Your details
details.lede: So we can get in touch to confirm.

confirmation.heading: Booking Confirmed!
confirmation.body: A confirmation is on its way to your inbox. We look forward to meeting you.

datetime.heading: Choose a date and time
datetime.lede: Pick a day, then a time that suits you.
datetime.pickDay: Pick a day to see the free times.

review.heading: Check your booking
review.lede: Make sure everything looks right, then confirm.
review.note: We will email a confirmation straight away. There is nothing to pay.

toast.message: Your consultation is booked{suffix}. Check your inbox for the confirmation.
toast.error: Sorry, that did not send. Please try again, or call or email us instead.
toast.taken: Sorry, that time was just taken. Please choose another.

calendar.empty: No free days left this month. Try the next one.
